## Start in five minutes

Keys are issued by email (free; the first 10 cases are the trial). Then: [first verification](/docs/start/first-verification/) → [write your own artefact](/docs/guides/write-a-verifiable-lean-artefact/) → [check a certificate like a relying party](/docs/start/first-certificate-check/).

## Role packs

### Guest
Unauthenticated evaluator — judge it before you join it.

### Users
Key-holders — the working set.

### Developers
Integrators and agent builders.

### Maintainers
Evidence on request — boundary published, internals not.

### Regulators
Policy first, control → evidence index.

### Admins
Account administration as it actually works today.

### Ops
Surfaces, health evidence, the incident rule.

### About this documentation

Every page carries its audience, Diátaxis type, version, last-verified date, source artefact, and a Markdown mirror (linked in the meta block). Status, lifecycle, and pricing facts are generated from the same canonical sources as the [status page](/status/) and are covered by CI drift checks. The Maintainers pack is the one deliberate boundary: structure public, internals on request.

Documentation error? It is a product error — report it on [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/nrupala/axiomcode/issues), user-initiated only.
